title: ModellingPreview passes config={{}} to SummaryTab, silently dropping the user's MLflow experiment_name and model_name on export
description: ModellingPreview renders <SummaryTab ... config={{}} />. SummaryTab forwards `config` into MlflowExportSection, which derives the MLflow request fields via configField(config, "mlflow_experiment", "") and configField(config, "model_name", ""). Because an empty object is passed, both lookups return "" → coerced to null, so when the user clicks "Log to MLflow" from the modelling result panel, the experiment name and model name they configured on the Modelling node are silently discarded and the run is logged under a default/unnamed experiment. These two keys are real persisted config: SplitAndMetricsConfig.tsx (lines 215-227) writes `mlflow_experiment` and `model_name` onto the modelling node's config via onUpdate. ModellingPreview has `nodeId` in scope and the node config is reachable from the graph store (the codebase reads node config by id elsewhere, e.g. App.tsx:634 `nodeData(activeNode).config ?? {}`), so the real config is available — the hardcoded `{}` is an oversight, not a necessity. This is the only place the modelling flow surfaces the MLflow export (ModellingConfig does not render MlflowExportSection), so there is no other path that supplies the correct names.
evidence: ModellingPreview.tsx:111 `<SummaryTab result={result} jobId={data.jobId} mlflowBackend={mlflowBackend} config={{}} />` → SummaryTab.tsx:194 `<MlflowExportSection trainJobId={jobId} mlflowBackend={mlflowBackend} config={config} />` → MlflowExportSection.tsx:40-41 `experiment_name: configField(config, "mlflow_experiment", "") || null, model_name: configField(config, "model_name", "") || null`. configField.ts:14-16 returns fallback when key absent, so with config={} both resolve to "" then null. The keys originate from SplitAndMetricsConfig.tsx:215-227 (`onUpdate("mlflow_experiment", ...)`, `onUpdate("model_name", ...)`). The export button is reachable whenever MLflow is connected (ModellingPreview.tsx:62 sets mlflowBackend.installed=true on status==="connected"; SummaryTab.tsx:189 gates on `mlflowBackend?.installed && jobId`).
